limitations: Capacity batches are a proxy, not measured occupancy or scheduling.
Tile logical block1/maxthreads never stand for physical cooperating threads.
Partial resources and unmodelled local-memory regimes are excluded, not zero-filled.
Rank/conditioning diagnose identifiability, not causal mechanism.
Held-out results are neither accepted nor opened by this calibration command.
reproduction_scope: Replay frozen coefficients, scores, choices and residuals; recorded rank/conditioning is retained, not refitted.
